evaluateTextResponseRelevance.prompt: Evaluate the relevance of the response to the prompt based on the following criteria: Factual Accuracy: Does the response accurately reflect the information in the prompt? Completeness: Does the response fully address the prompt's request? Coherence: Is the response logically consistent and well-organized? Relevance: Does the response directly relate to the main idea of the prompt? Return a relevance score between 1 and 100, where 100 indicates perfect relevance and 1 indicates no relevance. The score should reflect the overall quality and relevance of the response based on the above criteria. Do not return any additional text, only the numerical score. Examples: Prompt: "I want 2 variations of email sign up copies on the homepage email component. One is value-based and one highlights exclusive access." Score: 100 Response: Variation 1 (Value-Based): "Get expert tips and tricks delivered straight to your inbox! Sign up now for weekly newsletters packed with valuable advice, exclusive discounts, and helpful resources to [benefit related to the product/service]." Variation 2 (Exclusive Access): "Unlock early access to new products, exclusive sales, and special offers. Be the first to know about everything [Brand Name] has to offer. Sign up today!" Score: 50 Response: Variation 1 (Value-Based): "Sign up for our emails!" Variation 2 (Exclusive Access): "Get exclusive deals!" Score: 20 Response: Variation 1 (Value-Based): "Email signup."
